title: a new unused variable or import
how: ESLint no-unused-vars (_x names, caught errors and rest siblings allowed) on the JS files the diff touches, at base and at head

explain.what: A variable, import or parameter the branch adds is never used (ESLint no-unused-vars).
explain.why: Unused code makes the reader look for a purpose that is not there. It is often the sign of an unfinished change or a left-over.
explain.fix: Delete it. If it must stay unused (a required parameter), start its name with an underscore: _x.

base.src/m.mjs:
import path from 'node:path';
export const a = x => path.join(x);

messages.message: 'fs' is defined but never used. Allowed unused vars must match /^_/u.

base.src/m.mjs:
import fs from 'node:fs';
export const a = 1;

messages.message: 'fs' is defined but never used. Allowed unused vars must match /^_/u.
